application_note: Feature definitions, lags, transformations, interactions and calendar controls are copied verbatim. Venue mapping is governed by semantic_parity.json; no feature has been added or retuned.

registry.common_sample_policy: S0 and S1 are evaluated on identical dates, requiring every S1 field to be finite even for S0.
registry.complete_case: same asset-date rows for all information sets; all required S0 and S1 fields finite and target finite; no imputation

derived_definitions.interactions: current t products as named; no other polynomial/pairwise terms
derived_definitions.oi_shock_30d_robust: (oi_log_change[t]-median(oi_log_change[t-180:t-1]))/(1.4826*MAD(oi_log_change[t-180:t-1])); exactly 180 prior four-hour intervals, no current value in denominator; zero MAD -> missing

registry.feature_timing: six current/past 4-hour intervals t-5..t; interval-t values are available only at its end; target starts at t+1
registry.target_definition: arithmetic mean of spot_amihud at t+1,...,t+6; all six future intervals required
